props.text: Take the **morning ferry**; book the return by Friday.

props.title: Check the forecast
props.text: Typhoon season runs to October.

props.title: Lisbon in December
props.subtitle: Five days, 14 to 19 December. Planning notes for the group.

props.text:
Mild and wet: **12 to 16 °C**, rain on about half the days. Trams and the old town are better in the rain than they sound; the **Christmas lights** are on from early December.

Flights are the cost that moves, so book those first.

items.value: Not needed for a Hong Kong passport (90 days)

items.label: Sat 14
items.title: Arrive, Alfama walk
items.text: Land mid-morning, metro to the apartment, then a slow walk through the old town at dusk.

items.label: Sun 15
items.title: Belém
items.text: Tram 15 or train from Cais do Sodré; the pastry queue is shortest before 10:00.

items.label: Mon 16
items.title: Day trip to Sintra
items.text: Go early; buy the palace tickets online, the queues are long.

items.label: Tue 17

items.text: Markets, the tiles museum, a fado evening (book ahead).

items.title: Getting around
items.text:
Buy a **Viva Viagem** card at any metro station and load it with zapping credit; it works on metro, trams and buses.

The hills are steep: comfortable shoes matter more than a map.

items.title: Eating
items.text:
Lunch menus (*prato do dia*) are the cheapest good meal, usually €10 to €13 with a drink.

- Book dinner on Friday and Saturday
- Many kitchens close between 15:00 and 19:00

items.title: If it rains all day
items.text: The tiles museum, the aquarium, and the covered **Time Out Market** all work.

props.caption: Hours online each day, Monday to Sunday: busiest on the two game nights

props.text:
A quiet week. The **Saturday dinner** went ahead with six people, and the server stayed up through both game nights.

- Two plans moved by a day after a weather change
- One reminder was snoozed twice, then done

props.title: Next week
props.text: Two birthdays fall on the weekend; nothing is planned yet.

props.title: Which apartment?
props.subtitle: Two options for the December trip

props.text: more charming
Old-town views and a quiet street. The four flights of stairs are the catch, with luggage and in the rain.
cheaper
Next to the metro and a lift. Noisier at night, especially on weekends.

props.title: Baixa flat
props.text: It is cheaper, the airport link is easier, and a lift matters with four suitcases. The loft wins only if quiet is the priority.

props.title: 19:00 Dinner
props.description: a table for six is held until 19:15

props.text:
Hot pot place near the station.

- **Order first:** the broth and two platters to share
- **Skip:** the set menu, it is smaller than it looks
- Booking is under *Ken*
A bar with a quiet back room; it takes no bookings, so arrive before 22:00.

props.title: Last train
props.text: 00:42 from the station; leave the bar by 00:15.
Most stalls are the **world save**, not the process. Look before you restart.

docker ps --filter name=game
docker logs --tail 50 game

props.title: Save first
props.text: A restart during a save can lose the last few minutes of progress.
docker restart game
Wait about **40 seconds** for the world to load.
Open the game's page and use the restart control. It saves first, then restarts.

items.title: It still will not come up
items.text:
Check free disk space, then the last lines of the log:

```
df -h /data
```

A full disk is the usual cause.

items.title: Rolling back a save
items.text: Backups are kept daily for a week. Restore the newest one from **before** the problem began.
